Topic: Book an available Slot with a chosen Specialist
User Story: As a Client, I want to book an available Slot with a chosen Specialist, so that I secure the Appointment without calling the clinic.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. When a Client selects an available Slot and confirms, the system shall create an Appointment in status "Booked" and display the confirmation to the Client.
2. If a Client attempts to book a Slot that is no longer available, then the system shall reject the booking and display the current published Availability for that Specialist.
3. When a Client selects an available Slot, the system shall place a Hold on that Slot for five minutes.
4. If a Hold reaches five minutes without a confirmation, then the system shall release the Slot and display the refreshed Availability to the Client.
5. If a Client already holds the BR-001 maximum of Appointments in status "Booked", then the system shall block the booking and display that Client's own Appointments in status "Booked".
6. When an Appointment is created, the system shall notify the Specialist of the new Appointment.
7. Only Slots the Specialist has published are offered.
8. A Slot whose start time has passed is never offered.
9. Scenario: Two Clients race for the last Slot
10. A Client may hold at most 3 Appointments in status "Booked" at the same time.

User Story: As a Client, I want to cancel my own Appointment, so that the Slot returns to the Specialist when I give enough notice.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. When a Client cancels an own Appointment more than 24 hours before its start_time (BR-002), the system shall set the Appointment status to "Cancelled" and return the Slot to the Specialist's published Availability.
2. When a Client cancels an own Appointment 24 hours before its start_time (BR-002), the system shall set the Appointment status to "Cancelled" and keep the Slot unavailable for rebooking.
3. A Client cannot cancel an Appointment that belongs to another Client.
4. Cancellation inside 24h of start_time keeps the Slot unavailable for rebooking (BR-002).
5. Cancellation more than 24h before start_time returns the Slot to the Specialist's published Availability (BR-002).
6. Free cancellation window: strictly more than 24 hours before start_time. Inside 24h, cancellation is allowed but the Slot is NOT released for rebooking.

Topic: Cancel an Appointment I cannot attend
User Story: As a Specialist, I want to cancel an Appointment I cannot attend, so that the Client learns of it at the earliest moment.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. When a Specialist cancels an Appointment on their own Availability, the system shall set the Appointment status to "Cancelled" and notify the Client of the cancellation.
2. A Specialist can cancel only an Appointment on their own Availability.
3. The Client receives a cancellation notice naming the Appointment's start_time.
